create_AverageMeter: create an AverageMeter to compute and store average and current values across training epochs
update_AverageMeter: update an AverageMeter with a new value and optional sample count for running averages
create_Stats: create a Stats object to log training metrics like loss and accuracy across epochs
plot_Stats: plot training statistics to a visdom server or save as a PDF file with matplotlib
save_Stats: save a Stats object to a gzipped JSON file and later load it back
